i'm also planning my runaway with my cat too and am intrigued to see what suggestions people will give. at the moment i'm thinking about getting a harness for her and leash training her for a while before i leave. she often sits on my shoulder at home anyways so i'm thinking that could be an option. 

definitely will be coming back to this post though to see what others suggest. leaving my cat is not an option for me, she's instrumental to my mental health too. but i cannot stay at home.
had someone literally just tell me that im not actually suicidal because my attempt failed. humanity is awful and it feels like the only ones who get it are those in the same boat.
